title: race_reset
description: Emitted when a new race starts: a track command, a track changed in game, or the game restarting the race

reason.description: Why the race started. track_change: a set_track or next_track, sent as the command arrives, before the new track loads, so the room still names the old track. room_track_change: the track was changed in game, sent right after the track_changed that reports it. room_sgso_start: the room's shared game state restarted. actor_<n>_rs_reset: a pilot's race state was reset.
